sources: https://docs-v1.paystack.com/docs/events — "Structure of an event object" (the full invoice.payment_failed payload: status "pending", paid false, paid_at null, transaction {} — an EMPTY transaction object)
https://paystack.com/docs/payments/webhooks/ — "Types of events": invoice.payment_failed — "A payment for an invoice failed"
https://paystack.com/docs/payments/subscriptions/ — "Listen for subscription events": "If not, an invoice.payment_failed event will be sent instead" (instead of charge.success)
verifiedFieldNames: data.transaction (empty object when the charge did not produce one)
provenance.adaptedValues: Field names, nesting and types are exactly as published; values adapted to the sandbox GHS flow. TWO published quirks are preserved deliberately: (1) period_start is AFTER period_end in the provider's own example — the normalizer maps the period exactly as reported and enforces no ordering, because the provider publishes no such invariant; (2) the subscription object here DOES carry an email_token — the provider's cancellation credential — which the normalizer never reads, never maps and never persists.
neverRead: data.subscription.email_token (the provider's cancellation credential — read by no code path in this package)
